title: Netmaker — Papercraft Unfolder
description: Pick a polyhedron, watch it unfold into a papercraft net with glue tabs, and export a print-ready SVG.
concept: Netmaker turns a solid into something you can actually cut out and build. Choose from ten named polyhedra or four parametric families, and the app derives the faces itself: a brute-force convex hull over the vertex set, coplanar facets merged into real polygons. It then walks a randomised spanning tree across the face dual graph to flatten the solid into one connected net, checks every face pair for overlap, and hangs trapezoidal glue tabs off each seam. Set your paper size and edge length in millimetres, re-unfold until the layout is clean, and download an SVG with true mm units and separate cut, fold and tab layers.
features: 14 solids — 5 Platonic, 5 Archimedean, plus parametric prisms, antiprisms, pyramids and bipyramids (3–12 sides)
Faces derived live by convex hull with tolerance-based coplanar merging — no hard-coded face tables
Randomised spanning-tree unfolder with overlap detection; 'Re-unfold' searches 26 seeds for a clean layout
Automatic glue tabs that shrink or drop when they would collide with a neighbouring face
Millimetre workflow: A4/Letter/A3 sheets, edge-length slider, binary-search 'fit edge to page', live scale bar
Linked 3D view showing which edges the current net cuts open (rose) and which stay folded (mint)
Print-ready SVG export with mm units and layered cut / fold / tab groups, plus a 6px-per-mm PNG
Share links encode the whole design in the URL hash; designs and last state persist in localStorage

interaction.mouse: Drag the top pane to orbit the solid; drag the net to pan; wheel to zoom; double-click to recentre.
interaction.click: Pick a solid, flip tabs/numbers/tint, re-unfold for a new layout, or export SVG/PNG.
interaction.touch: Touch-drag orbits and pans, two-finger pinch zooms the net, and a bottom sheet holds the full control panel.
interaction.keyboard: R re-unfolds · F fits the edge to the page · S saves · E exports SVG · P exports PNG · Space toggles spin · arrows orbit.
